pairs.zh_text: 随着工业废气排放标准日益严格，开发高效、稳定的低温脱硝催化剂已成为大气污染控制领域的研究热点。
pairs.en_text: Stricter industrial emission standards have made efficient and stable low-temperature denitration catalysts a priority for air pollution control.

pairs.zh_text: 本项目拟以纳米二氧化钛为载体，负载锰铈复合氧化物，构建具有核壳结构的低温选择性催化还原（SCR）催化剂。
pairs.en_text: We will load manganese-cerium mixed oxide onto nanoscale titania to construct a core-shell catalyst for low-temperature selective catalytic reduction (SCR).

pairs.zh_text: 通过原位红外光谱与密度泛函理论计算相结合，阐明锰铈界面协同作用对NH3吸附活化的调控机制。
pairs.en_text: We will combine in situ infrared spectroscopy with density functional theory calculations to clarify how manganese-cerium interfacial synergy regulates NH3 adsorption and activation.

pairs.zh_text: 前期研究已制备出MnOx-CeO2/TiO2催化剂，在150至250摄氏度窗口内NOx转化率达到92%以上[1]。
pairs.en_text: In preliminary work, our MnOx-CeO2/TiO2 catalyst converted more than 92% of NOx across the 150-250 °C window [1].

pairs.zh_text: 文献[2]（2020年）报道的同类体系在含硫气氛中易失活，本项目拟引入钇掺杂以提升抗硫性能。
pairs.en_text: The analogous system reported in reference [2] (2020) deactivates readily in sulfur-containing atmospheres; we will therefore introduce yttrium doping to improve sulfur resistance.

pairs.zh_text: 预期成果将为柴油车尾气净化提供理论依据与技术支撑，具有重要的科学意义和应用前景。
pairs.en_text: The expected outcomes will inform diesel vehicle exhaust purification and offer both mechanistic insight and application value.
